brand.title: Impact Dashboard

hero.badge: Gahunda yo Kongera Ubudahangarwa ku Mihindagurikire y'Ikirere
hero.headline: Gukurikirana Isanwa ry'Ibibaya n'Imibereho Myiza y'Abaturage
hero.subheadline: Kwerekana uburyo gutera amashyamba, amaterasi, no kurinda inkombe birinda imyuzure ikabije, bigafata imisozi ihanamye, bikanaha abaturage imirimo ibatunze.

stories.title: Inkuru z'Ibibaya n'Ibyavuye mu Mirimo
stories.subtitle: Inkuru zifatika zigaragaza uburyo gusana imisozi byahinduye imibereho y'abaturage.
stories.story1_title: Gusana Umukoki wa Mpazi: Kurinda Nyabugogo Imyuzure y'Inkukuma
stories.story1_desc: Uburyo ingomero z'ibiti, imigano ku nkombe, n'ibyobo bifata amazi mu misozi yo hejuru birinda amazu n'amasoko y'i Nyabugogo kurengerwa n'amazi.
stories.story2_title: Abagore ku Ruhembo: Amakoperative y'Abagore Ayoboye Ubuhumbikiro bw'Ibiti
stories.story2_desc: Hafi 61% by'ubuhumbikiro bw'ingemwe buyobowe n'amakoperative y'abagore, bigatuma amafaranga yinjira mu mibereho myiza y'ingo zabo.
stories.story3_title: Urubyiruko n'Ikoranabuhanga rya GIS: Gukurikirana Amashyamba hakoreshejwe Drone
stories.story3_desc: Guha urubyiruko ubushobozi n'ibikoresho byo gupima amashyamba no kureba niba ibiti byatewe bikura neza mu bubiko bw'amakuru.

climate.name: Kwirinda Imihindagurikire y'Ikirere
climate.short_desc: Kugabanya inkangu, kurinda imyuzure, no gufata amazi y'isuri ku misozi ihanamiye n'imikoki.
climate.headline: Kubaka Ubudahangarwa kuva ku Misozi kugera mu Bibaya
climate.what_is_it: Kwirinda imihindagurikire y'ikirere bikoresha uburyo bwo guca amaterasi, gutera imigano ku nkombe, no gutera amashyamba ku misozi kugira ngo bifate amazi y'imvura idasanzwe.
climate.why_it_matters: Imvura nyinshi iteza imyuzure mu mikoki ya Mpazi na Nyabugogo, ikangiza ibikorwa remezo n'ubuzima bw'abaturage barenga 250,000.
climate.what_action_does: Ibikorwa birimo gusana imisozi ya Yanze, Mpazi, na Mont Kigali hacibwa amaterasi kandi hagaterwa ibyatsi bifata ubutaka mbere y'uko amazi agera mu bice bituwe.

biodiversity.name: Kubungabunga Urusobe rw'Ibinyabuzima
biodiversity.short_desc: Kugarura ibiti gakondo, kurinda metero 30 z'inkombe za Nyabarongo, no gusigasira ibishanga.
biodiversity.headline: Kugarura Ibiti Gakondo n'Inzira z'Urusobe rw'Ibinyabuzima
biodiversity.what_is_it: Kurengera urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima byibanda ku gutera ibiti gakondo nk'Umwungo n'Umusave, no kubahiriza metero 30 z'inkombe z'imigezi n'ibishanga.
biodiversity.why_it_matters: Ibiti by'inkombe bituma amazi y'uruganda rwa Yanze akomeza kuba meza kandi atunganye.
biodiversity.what_action_does: Abafatanyabikorwa batera ingemwe zirenga miliyoni 1.2, bakarinda ibirometero 45 by'inkombe z'imigezi, kandi bagakurikirana ibiti byatewe hakoreshejwe GPS.

gesi.name: Uburinganire n'Ubwuzuzanye (GESI)
gesi.short_desc: Gushyira abagore mu buyobozi bwa komite z'amazi, guha urubyiruko akazi ka GIS, no kuzamura ingo zikennye.
gesi.headline: Gushyira Abagore n'Urubyiruko ku Isonga mu Butegetsi bw'Ibidukikije
gesi.what_is_it: Uburinganire bugamije gushyira abagore, urubyiruko, n'abatishoboye mu nzego zifata ibyemezo no kubaha inyungu zikomoka ku kurengera ibibaya.
gesi.why_it_matters: Abagore n'urubyiruko nibo bibasirwa cyane n'ingaruka z'ikirere ariko kenshi ntibagire uruhare mu nama n'ubutaka. Iterambere rirambye risaba ko bose babyibonamo.
gesi.what_action_does: Gahunda isaba ko nibura 50% by'abayobozi ba komite baba abagore, igatera inkunga ubuhumbikiro bw'amakoperative y'abagore, ikanahugura urubyiruko mu gupima amashyamba.

economy.name: Umurimo n'Iterambere ry'Umutungo
economy.short_desc: Guhanga imirimo y'icyatsi, gufasha abahinzi b'ibiti bivangwa n'imyaka, no kwinjiza amafaranga mu buhumbikiro.
economy.headline: Guhanga Imirimo Irambye n'Ubukungu bw'Icyatsi mu Nkengero z'Umujyi
economy.what_is_it: Inkingi y'ubukungu ihuza kurengera ibidukikije no guha abaturage amafaranga binyuze mu guhemberwa guca amaterasi, kugurisha imbuto, no kugurisha ingemwe z'ibiti.
economy.why_it_matters: Abaturiye ibibaya bakeneye amikoro atuma baha agaciro ibidukikije aho kubyangiza, bigatuma ibyakozwe biramba.
economy.what_action_does: Ibikorwa bimaze gutanga iminsi y'akazi yishyuwe, guha abahinzi 2,850 ingemwe z'avoka n'imyembe, no kwinjiza miliyoni 48 RWF mu buhumbikiro.

map_section.title: Ikarita y'Ikibaya n'Ahakorerwa Imirimo
map_section.subtitle: Suzuma imipaka y'ibibaya by'amazi, ahatewe amashyamba, ubwoko bw'ibiti, n'uduce tw'amajyambere.
map_section.select_prompt: Kanda ku kadomo cyangwa agace k'amazi ku ikarita kugira ngo ubone ibisobanuro birambuye.

indicator_explorer.title: Urubuga rw'Ibipimo n'Umusaruro
indicator_explorer.subtitle: Suzuma igipimo cyose mu gukanda kabiri gusa: Ibisobanuro n'Inkuru, Imbonerahamwe y'Igihe, Ikarita y'Ahakorerwa, n'Intego z'Iterambere (SDGs).
indicator_explorer.search_placeholder: Shakisha mu bipimo (urugero: imyuzure, ibiti, imirimo, abagore, kode y'ububiko)...
indicator_explorer.two_clicks_prompt: Hitamo inkingi cyangwa igipimo hano hasi kugira ngo ubone inkuru n'imbonerahamwe yacyo.

mypeg_workspace.sdg_title: Guhuza n'Intego z'Iterambere Rirambye z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye (SDGs)
mypeg_workspace.sdg_subtitle: Uburyo iki gipimo cyunganira gahunda y'Isi ya 2030.

registry_interoperability.title: Ikoranabuhanga rihuza n'Ububiko bw'Amakuru
registry_interoperability.subtitle: Byubatswe mu buryo bworohereza inzego guhanahana amakuru nta mbogamizi.
registry_interoperability.card1_desc: Buri gace k'imirimo gahujwe na kode zemewe z'igenzura (urugero: COMP-GAS-JB-01) n'amoko y'ibiti.
registry_interoperability.card2_desc: Amakuru yose n'amakarita bishobora gukurwamo ako kanya hifashishijwe amadosiye ya JSON.
registry_interoperability.card3_desc: Byubatswe mu buryo bworohereza abakozi b'ikoranabuhanga kubicunga bitabagoye.

footer.about: Impact Dashboard ni urubuga rufunguye rwo gukurikirana ibipimo n'isesengura ry'amakuru, rushyigikira ubudahangarwa ku mihindagurikire y'ikirere n'iterambere ry'abaturage.
footer.rights: Amakuru yose y'ubugenzuzi ashyizwe ahagaragara ku buntu mu rwego rwo gukorera mu mucyo.
